classification.difficultyReason: Infer the tangent gradient from a parallel line, locate the point of tangency and express the tangent in general form.

content.prompt:
A function $f(x)=2x^2-8x+3$ has a tangent parallel to line $4x-2y+1=0$ at point $P$.
Find the equation of the tangent at $P$ in general form.

answer.worked:
The parallel line has gradient $2$, so the tangent also has gradient $2$.
$$\begin{aligned}
f'(x)&=4x-8\\
4x-8&=2\\
4x&=10\\
x&=\frac52
\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned}
f\left(\frac52\right)&=2\left(\frac52\right)^2-8\left(\frac52\right)+3\\
&=\frac{25}{2}-20+3\\
&=-\frac92
\end{aligned}$$
Using $P\left(\frac52,-\frac92\right)$ and $m=2$:
$$\begin{aligned}
y-y_1&=m(x-x_1)\\
y-\left(-\frac92\right)&=2\left(x-\frac52\right)\\
y+\frac92&=2x-5\\
2y+9&=4x-10\\
4x-2y-19&=0
\end{aligned}$$
